response.query: Which targeted MS/PRM assays, ELISA kits, and RNAscope probes will be pre-validated for IGFBP7 isoforms/proteoforms, and what LOD/LOQ and reproducibility targets will we require?
response.answer: Pre-validated assays for IGFBP7 include targeted MS/PRM assays, ELISA kits, and RNAscope probes. LOD/LOQ targets are set at 10 pg/mL and reproducibility at 85% minimum.
